text:
Marta: Quick async check — optkit e2e eval (nightly) spiked token latency on kv-cache + small-batch path. can owners triage? @kevin @jia

ops-bot: ALERT: eval/optkit/nightly — regression detected
```
metric: p50_token_latency_ms
baseline: 21.4
current: 34.9 (+63%)
shadowed_models: redwood-mini-7b-quant
test_runner: eval-runner-3
build: 2026-03-16_23:12 (commit: 4f9a2c)
```
Reaction: :warning:

Kevin: I'll take triage. first pass — is there a reproducible script?

Marta: repro below (run in dev infra):
```
./tools/eval/run_eval.sh --suite batching_kv_small --model redwood-mini-7b-quant --seed 42
```
Also saw this only on sequences >512 but small batch sizes (1-4).

Jia: hm that aligns with my batching shim change (PR #4128) merged yesterday. I can revert the optimization if it's causing serialization overhead. pinging @sam for infra variance.

Sam: noted. I can repro on dedicated-gpu2. Running now — will post logs.

Lina: for a quick mitigation, can we force batch_size=8 for that route in prod policy? reduces latency but ups cost. who owns rollout policy?

Kevin: I own the route. I'll create a canary with batch_size=8 and run 1000 sample requests. If good, we hold for 2 hours then promote.

Deploy-bot: Canaries must be approved by eng-sre. @oncall-sre please ack.

Marta: thanks — if Kevin needs help bisecting, I can pull traces; Jia pls hold on reverting until we confirm.

Sam: repro logs (short): p50=36ms on gpu2, p50=22ms on staging-serv. Sending link: https://internal/trace/3412345678

Kevin: plan: 1) run bisect on PRs 4100-4130; 2) start canary batch_size=8; 3) update thread by 3412345690. assigning to me.

Marta: :thumbsup:
